'''University of Liverpool Mathematics School''' (abbreviated as '''University of Liverpool Maths School''' and '''ULMaS''') is a [[coeducational]] [[maths school]] in [[Central, Liverpool]], in the English county of [[Merseyside]].<ref name=":0" /> It was opened by the [[University of Liverpool]]<ref>{{Cite web |title=University of Liverpool Maths School for sixth formers |url=https://www.liverpool.ac.uk/mathematics-school/ |access-date=2022-04-07 |website=University of Liverpool}}</ref> in September 2020 as the third [[Specialist school|specialist]] maths school in the country<ref>{{Cite web |last=Staufenberg |first=Jess |date=2020-10-13 |title=Do maths schools have proof of concept yet? |url=https://schoolsweek.co.uk/the-idea-is-totally-solid-%e2%80%a8it-just-works/ |access-date=2022-04-07 |website=Schools Week |language=en-GB}}</ref> and the first in [[Northern England]].<ref>{{Cite web |date=2020-09-04 |title=Specialist maths school opens in Liverpool |url=https://lbndaily.co.uk/specialist-maths-school-opens-liverpool/ |access-date=2022-04-07 |website=Liverpool Business News |language=en-GB}}</ref> It is located on the university's campus, in the Sir [[Alastair Pilkington]] Building, and offers a curriculum specialising in [[A-level mathematics|A-Level mathematics]] (including [[Further Mathematics|further mathematics]]), [[physics]] and [[computer science]].<ref>{{Cite web |date=2020-09-07 |title=Liverpool gets first specialist maths school in north of England |url=https://liverpoolexpress.co.uk/liverpool-gets-first-specialist-maths-school-in-north-of-england/ |access-date=2022-04-07 |website=Liverpool Express |language=en-GB}}</ref>

== History ==
{{Quote box
| quote = The University of Liverpool Mathematics College will be a hub for the most able young mathematicians in the Liverpool city region so they can develop their knowledge and skills through the study of maths and related subjects. In today’s global economy it is essential that the UK develops the potential of our most able maths students and this initiative will help respond to that challenge.
| source = —University of Liverpool [[Vice-chancellor|Vice-Chancellor]] [[Janet Beer]]<ref name=":1" />
| align = left
| width = 23em
| salign = left
}}
In July 2018 the [[Department for Education]], with [[Lord Agnew]] and [[Liz Truss]], announced plans to establish the University of Liverpool Mathematics College. It would be a maths school offering the subjects of A-Level mathematics, further mathematics, physics, and computer science, and would enrol 80 students per year.<ref name=":1">{{OGL-attribution|{{Cite web |title=Skills boost for the North as maths school to open in Liverpool |url=https://www.gov.uk/government/news/skills-boost-for-the-north-as-maths-school-to-open-in-liverpool |access-date=2022-04-07 |website=GOV.UK |language=en}}}}</ref> An offer of music was also considered.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2018-06-04 |title=North West to get specialist Maths college |url=https://www.itv.com/news/granada/update/2018-07-04/nw-to-get-specialist-maths-college/ |access-date=2022-04-07 |website=ITV News |language=en}}</ref> The [[New Schools Network]], made to support [[Free schools in England|free schools]] (including maths schools), welcomed the announcement.<ref>{{Cite web |title=NSN welcomes the announcement that the University of Liverpool Mathematics College will open in 2020 |url=https://www.newschoolsnetwork.org/what-are-free-schools/free-school-news/nsn-welcomes-the-announcement-that-the-university-of |access-date=2022-04-07 |website=New Schools Network}}</ref> The University of Liverpool promoted this college to [[Year Eleven]] pupils in multiple schools throughout April 2019.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2019-04-23 |title=Where might maths take you? |url=https://alumni.liv.ac.uk/news/stories/title,1139398,en.html |access-date=2022-04-07 |website=University of Liverpool}}</ref>

By June 2020 the college's name had been changed to University of Liverpool Mathematics School. A headteacher, Damian Haigh, was appointed. The first teaching staff were recruited through [[video call]] as a result of the [[COVID-19 pandemic in England|COVID-19 pandemic]]. The Department for Education reached a funding agreement with the [https://find-and-update.company-information.service.gov.uk/company/11686521 University of Liverpool Mathematics School Trust] to enable it to open the school in September 2020.<ref name=":2">{{Cite web |date=2020-06-05 |title=UK's third specialist Mathematics School to open in Liverpool |url=https://www.educatemagazine.com/liverpool-maths-school/ |access-date=2022-04-07 |website=Educate magazine |language=en-GB}}</ref> The college opened on 1 September 2020<ref name=":0" /> but the official opening ceremony did not take place until 30 September 2021. Doctor Steve Garnett was the guest of honour at the official opening ceremony,<ref name=":3">{{Cite web |date=2021-09-30 |title=University of Liverpool specialist Mathematics School officially opened |url=https://www.liverpool.ac.uk/mathematical-sciences/news/articles/university-of-liverpool-specialist-mathematics-school-offically-opened/ |access-date=2022-04-07 |website=University of Liverpool}}</ref> a business magnate who previously spoke at the college.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2021-07-06 |title=University's specialist Maths School welcomes Liverpool tech entrepreneur |url=https://www.liverpool.ac.uk/mathematical-sciences/news/articles/universitys-specialist-maths-school-welcomes-liverpool-tech-entrepreneur/ |access-date=2022-04-07 |website=University of Liverpool}}</ref>

Between January 2021 and the start of March 2021, due to the [[COVID-19 pandemic]], [[distance education]] arrangements were in effect. Physical face-to-face teaching resumed on 8 March under new preventative measures, such as [[Face masks during the COVID-19 pandemic|compulsory face masks]] in areas where [[social distancing]] could not be enforced. Students were also offered campus [[COVID-19 tests]] and some testing equipment for home usage.<ref>{{Cite web |title=8th March return to school and covid-19 testing information |url=https://liverpoolmathsschool.org/8th-march-return-to-school-and-covid_19-testing-information/ |access-date=2022-04-07 |website=University of Liverpool Maths School |language=en}}</ref>
